# Chief Architect — The Inform Team
### Role Profile v2 — Negotiated Version (Dom / Erica)
> **This is the shaped/negotiated version of the role.**
> Original posted JD: `2026-06-09_senior-solutions-architect-inform-team.docx` (Senior Solutions Architect, £90-105k)
> This version: Chief Architect, £120,000 + performance bonus + long-term upside
> Key changes from v1: elevated title, expanded strategic remit, explicit practice-building accountability, performance upside mechanism

---

## Overview

| | |
|---|---|
| **Job title** | Chief Architect |
| **Type** | Permanent full-time employed role |
| **Salary** | £120,000 + performance bonus (15-20% of base) + long-term upside (phantom equity / AI practice profit-share — see below) |
| **Hours** | 40 hours per week, typically 09:00–18:00 |
| **Annual leave** | 26 days (including three days' festive break, rising at 5 and 10 years' service). Plus paid time off for volunteering, moving home, adopting a new pet, becoming a grandparent… and more! |
| **Location** | Remote-based, with occasional travel to client sites, team meetings and company events throughout the year |
| **Reporting to** | Co-founders / Leadership Team |
| **Practice leadership** | No direct reports on day one. You build through influence initially — shaping architecture, guiding delivery teams, mentoring colleagues. Explicit scope to build and lead an AI and Architecture practice as the Digital capability expands. |
| **Security vetting** | All our people hold BPSS clearance as a minimum. This role will require SC clearance, which we will arrange. You must have lived and worked in the UK for the last five years to be eligible. |

---

## Role Summary

The Inform Team is building a genuine technical capability — one that matches the ambition of what we do with the architectural depth it deserves. We're looking for a Chief Architect to own the technical direction of that capability, inside our business and across our client base.

This is a foundational appointment. You will be our first architecture-level leader — the person who defines what good looks like technically, builds the practice around it, and makes sure everything we design and deliver holds up under scrutiny.

The role spans two missions:

**Client-facing architecture.** You will be the trusted technical mind behind how our clients — primarily Microsoft 365 and Copilot-adopting organisations — design secure, well-governed, future-ready solutions. Many clients want to roll out Copilot and Copilot Studio agents but haven't done the groundwork. You frame the problem, design the target architecture, size the effort and sequence the work. You are the person senior stakeholders trust to translate business ambition into a credible technical plan.

**Internal transformation — our Frontier Firm ambition.** You will own the strategic direction of how we transform the way we work internally, using AI agents to reinvent our own processes. This is not a side project — it's a strategic priority with dedicated attention. You design how human-agent teams operate, set the guardrails, run the pilots, and create the patterns the rest of the business adopts. You set the standard that others follow.

Beyond delivery, you hold accountability for our technical credibility as a business: our approach to Microsoft partnership, the quality of our architecture thinking, and the growth of a practice that didn't exist before you joined.

---

## Key Responsibilities

### Architecture Leadership and Practice Building

- Own the technical direction of The Inform Team's AI and Architecture capability
- Define architecture standards, patterns and principles across client engagements and internal delivery
- Build a reusable set of accelerators, frameworks and reference architectures that scale our delivery
- Advance our Microsoft partner status — identify, pursue and achieve relevant Microsoft Solutions Partner and specialisation designations
- Develop the architecture practice: mentor and grow colleagues into credible AI and architecture practitioners
- Act as the escalation point for complex architectural decisions across the business
- Represent The Inform Team externally as a technical authority — at client sites, partner events and in thought leadership

### Solution and Data Architecture

- Design end-to-end solutions across Microsoft 365, the Power Platform and Azure — secure, scalable, compliant and maintainable
- Lead data architecture thinking for clients: data classification, information protection, retention and lifecycle, and how it maps onto the Microsoft estate
- Design Microsoft Purview implementations: DLP, sensitivity labels, data classification, retention and records management, insider risk and eDiscovery
- Assess and remediate clients' SharePoint and Microsoft 365 estates so their data foundations are ready for Copilot and agent-based approaches
- Define the AI-readiness governance baseline an organisation needs before safely deploying agents over its own data
- Define the right access and identity models: Entra ID groups, conditional access, RBAC, guest/B2B and lifecycle
- Produce clear, high-quality architecture artefacts — target-state designs, options appraisals, build-vs-buy recommendations and roadmaps

### Client-Facing Advisory

- Act as trusted technical advisor and architecture authority on Microsoft 365 decisions, translating business goals into a credible technical approach
- Run discovery sessions and workshops to understand client goals, model their processes and shape the solution
- Provide technical sign-off and assurance on solutions; support compliance with Microsoft best practice
- Support consultants and delivery teams with technical direction, ensuring what we design is what gets delivered

### Frontier Firm and Internal Transformation

- Own the strategic direction of our Frontier Firm ambition — reimagining how we work with AI agents at the centre
- Identify where human-agent teams can transform internal delivery, and design how those agents are built, governed and orchestrated
- Establish the guardrails — data governance, security and responsible-AI practices — that let us move fast safely
- Prototype, pilot and prove new ways of working; create the patterns and standards the wider business then adopts
- Champion the shift from tools to outcomes, helping colleagues become confident agent users who delegate to and direct AI effectively

### AI and Automation

- Architect solutions using Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio and agent-based approaches
- Advise on AI readiness, governance, licensing and the data foundations that make AI safe and effective
- Maintain broad awareness of the AI landscape beyond Microsoft — open-source tools, emerging platforms and generative AI developments — with a focus on practical application
- Bring awareness of AI risks, data considerations and responsible-AI practice to every design

---

## About You

Our values are critical to delighting our clients and to our success — working together, doing the right thing, delivering with creativity and passion. Your attitude is as important as your experience.

For this role, we're looking for someone who:

- **Thinks in systems and architecture** — you naturally see how the pieces fit together, and you can hold the whole picture while getting the detail right
- **Leads without formal authority** — you shape direction, build credibility and bring people with you through expertise and trust, not hierarchy
- **Communicates with confidence at board and senior level** — you can hold your own in a room with senior stakeholders, explain technical choices and trade-offs without jargon, and bring people along
- **Builds things as well as designing them** — you are not purely a whiteboard architect; you prototype, you validate, and you know when to get your hands dirty to prove a direction works
- **Is excited and curious about emerging technology** — you're already experimenting with AI tools, you read about new capabilities and you want to understand how things actually work
- **Balances innovation with pragmatism** — you're excited by new technology but grounded enough to know when a simpler solution is the right answer
- **Takes a proactive, problem-solving approach** — you identify opportunities and challenges before being asked

---

## You'll Have

### Microsoft 365 and Architecture

- Deep, demonstrable expertise across the Microsoft 365 ecosystem
- A track record of designing and delivering enterprise Microsoft 365 solutions
- Strong understanding of Azure services and how they complement the Microsoft 365 estate
- Experience producing architecture designs, options appraisals, estimates and roadmaps
- The judgment to know what "good enough" looks like and when to stop designing

### Data Governance, Security and Compliance

- Hands-on architecture experience with Microsoft Purview — DLP, sensitivity labels, data classification, retention and information protection
- A strong grasp of data architecture and how to classify, protect and govern information across a Microsoft estate
- Understanding of identity and access models (Entra ID, conditional access, RBAC, security groups)
- Awareness of compliance frameworks and what "good" governance looks like in regulated and security-cleared environments

### Power Platform

- Power Platform architecture, security and DLP
- An understanding of SharePoint and Dataverse as data stores
- Ability to set the guardrails and governance for citizen-developer and pro-developer use

### AI, Copilot and Agents

- Practical, hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Studio — building and deploying agents, not just advising on them
- Understanding of AI licensing models, governance and the data readiness that underpins successful AI adoption
- Awareness of AI risks, data considerations and responsible-AI practices

### Communication, Influence and Leadership

- Genuine ability to communicate and build credibility with senior stakeholders and founders
- Experience making architectural decisions and defending technical recommendations under pressure
- Comfortable leading workshops, discovery sessions and knowledge transfer
- Track record of growing technical capability in others — mentoring, enabling, not gatekeeping

---

## Desirable Skills and Experience

- Microsoft certifications (MS-102, Power Platform Solution Architect Expert, SC-400/SC-100, AI-900, Azure architect-level credentials or equivalent)
- Experience leading an internal transformation or AI ways-of-working programme
- Background spanning both technical architecture and consulting or advisory work
- Experience integrating or architecting across non-Microsoft SaaS platforms (Salesforce, Workday, ServiceNow) or a demonstrable platform-agnostic architecture approach
- Experience with PowerShell automation and the Microsoft Graph API
- Experience delivering solutions to public sector or security-cleared environments
- Prior experience building a technical practice or centre of excellence from scratch

---

## Compensation and Progression

**Base salary:** £120,000

**Performance bonus:** 15-20% of base, tied to personal and business performance metrics agreed at the start of each year.

**Long-term upside:** We want this role to share in the value it creates. We'll structure a long-term upside mechanism — phantom equity or AI/architecture practice profit-share — with vesting over four years. We'll agree the right structure together based on what works for the business.

**Progression:** We see this role growing with the business. The scope here is to build and own the architecture capability. As the practice grows and the Frontier Firm ambition matures, this role naturally expands — in remit, in team, and in reward.

---

## What We Offer

Because we embrace the opportunities from the technology we help roll out, we have flexible working patterns to fit in with your travel, families, personal development and other activities. We think this helps our team be the fully rounded experts our clients need.

We give you company leave between Christmas and New Year, monthly staff recognition rewards, contributory pension, private medical care, death-in-service cover and support for your learning and development.

Our support for employees under the WeCare scheme offers a range of benefits, including access to legal advice and online GP appointments. Some of our team are trained mental health first aiders and we're always reviewing how we support people's wellbeing.

On top of your salary, we offer referral fees to employees and contractors.

---

## About Inform

We are The Inform Team — experts in making digital transformation personal. A mix of change managers, communicators, designers, trainers and strategists, all united by a shared purpose: to make change happen.

What started as two lifelong friends at their kitchen tables has grown into a thriving team of over 90 experts and collaborators. Emma Henry and Samantha Kinstrey founded The Inform Team with one clear mission: to put people at the heart of technology change.

We're a remote-first organisation spanning the UK and beyond. We've worked with public and private sector organisations to help them adopt new technologies and ways of working — from assessing digital maturity and recommending changes, to shaping how that change is delivered, creating engaging communications and tailored training programmes.

**Our areas of expertise:** AI Adoption · Microsoft 365 adoption · Change and behaviours · Communications and engagement · Learning and adoption · Pharma and life sciences

---

*Chief Architect role profile — negotiated version, June 2026. For Dom's use in shaping the conversation with Erica Jefferies and The Inform Team leadership. Companion to the original posted JD (Senior Solutions Architect).*

The Inform Team is building a genuine technical capability — one that matches the ambition of what we do with the architectural depth it deserves. We're looking for a Chief Architect to own the technical direction of that capability, inside our business and across our client base.

This is a foundational appointment. You will be our first architecture-level leader — the person who defines what good looks like technically, builds the practice around it, and makes sure everything we design and deliver holds up under scrutiny.

The role spans two missions:

**Client-facing architecture.** You will be the trusted technical mind behind how our clients — primarily Microsoft 365 and Copilot-adopting organisations — design secure, well-governed, future-ready solutions. Many clients want to roll out Copilot and Copilot Studio agents but haven't done the groundwork. You frame the problem, design the target architecture, size the effort and sequence the work. You are the person senior stakeholders trust to translate business ambition into a credible technical plan.

**Internal transformation — our Frontier Firm ambition.** You will own the strategic direction of how we transform the way we work internally, using AI agents to reinvent our own processes. This is not a side project — it's a strategic priority with dedicated attention. You design how human-agent teams operate, set the guardrails, run the pilots, and create the patterns the rest of the business adopts. You set the standard that others follow.

Beyond delivery, you hold accountability for our technical credibility as a business: our approach to Microsoft partnership, the quality of our architecture thinking, and the growth of a practice that didn't exist before you joined.

---

## Key Responsibilities

### Architecture Leadership and Practice Building

- Own the technical direction of The Inform Team's AI and Architecture capability
- Define architecture standards, patterns and principles across client engagements and internal delivery
- Build a reusable set of accelerators, frameworks and reference architectures that scale our delivery
- Advance our Microsoft partner status — identify, pursue and achieve relevant Microsoft Solutions Partner and specialisation designations
- Develop the architecture practice: mentor and grow colleagues into credible AI and architecture practitioners
- Act as the escalation point for complex architectural decisions across the business
- Represent The Inform Team externally as a technical authority — at client sites, partner events and in thought leadership

### Solution and Data Architecture

- Design end-to-end solutions across Microsoft 365, the Power Platform and Azure — secure, scalable, compliant and maintainable
- Lead data architecture thinking for clients: data classification, information protection, retention and lifecycle, and how it maps onto the Microsoft estate
- Design Microsoft Purview implementations: DLP, sensitivity labels, data classification, retention and records management, insider risk and eDiscovery
- Assess and remediate clients' SharePoint and Microsoft 365 estates so their data foundations are ready for Copilot and agent-based approaches
- Define the AI-readiness governance baseline an organisation needs before safely deploying agents over its own data
- Define the right access and identity models: Entra ID groups, conditional access, RBAC, guest/B2B and lifecycle
- Produce clear, high-quality architecture artefacts — target-state designs, options appraisals, build-vs-buy recommendations and roadmaps

### Client-Facing Advisory

- Act as trusted technical advisor and architecture authority on Microsoft 365 decisions, translating business goals into a credible technical approach
- Run discovery sessions and workshops to understand client goals, model their processes and shape the solution
- Provide technical sign-off and assurance on solutions; support compliance with Microsoft best practice
- Support consultants and delivery teams with technical direction, ensuring what we design is what gets delivered

### Frontier Firm and Internal Transformation

- Own the strategic direction of our Frontier Firm ambition — reimagining how we work with AI agents at the centre
- Identify where human-agent teams can transform internal delivery, and design how those agents are built, governed and orchestrated
- Establish the guardrails — data governance, security and responsible-AI practices — that let us move fast safely
- Prototype, pilot and prove new ways of working; create the patterns and standards the wider business then adopts
- Champion the shift from tools to outcomes, helping colleagues become confident agent users who delegate to and direct AI effectively

### AI and Automation

- Architect solutions using Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio and agent-based approaches
- Advise on AI readiness, governance, licensing and the data foundations that make AI safe and effective
- Maintain broad awareness of the AI landscape beyond Microsoft — open-source tools, emerging platforms and generative AI developments — with a focus on practical application
- Bring awareness of AI risks, data considerations and responsible-AI practice to every design

---

## About You

Our values are critical to delighting our clients and to our success — working together, doing the right thing, delivering with creativity and passion. Your attitude is as important as your experience.

For this role, we're looking for someone who:

- **Thinks in systems and architecture** — you naturally see how the pieces fit together, and you can hold the whole picture while getting the detail right
- **Leads without formal authority** — you shape direction, build credibility and bring people with you through expertise and trust, not hierarchy
- **Communicates with confidence at board and senior level** — you can hold your own in a room with senior stakeholders, explain technical choices and trade-offs without jargon, and bring people along
- **Builds things as well as designing them** — you are not purely a whiteboard architect; you prototype, you validate, and you know when to get your hands dirty to prove a direction works
- **Is excited and curious about emerging technology** — you're already experimenting with AI tools, you read about new capabilities and you want to understand how things actually work
- **Balances innovation with pragmatism** — you're excited by new technology but grounded enough to know when a simpler solution is the right answer
- **Takes a proactive, problem-solving approach** — you identify opportunities and challenges before being asked

---

## You'll Have

### Microsoft 365 and Architecture

- Deep, demonstrable expertise across the Microsoft 365 ecosystem
- A track record of designing and delivering enterprise Microsoft 365 solutions
- Strong understanding of Azure services and how they complement the Microsoft 365 estate
- Experience producing architecture designs, options appraisals, estimates and roadmaps
- The judgment to know what "good enough" looks like and when to stop designing

### Data Governance, Security and Compliance

- Hands-on architecture experience with Microsoft Purview — DLP, sensitivity labels, data classification, retention and information protection
- A strong grasp of data architecture and how to classify, protect and govern information across a Microsoft estate
- Understanding of identity and access models (Entra ID, conditional access, RBAC, security groups)
- Awareness of compliance frameworks and what "good" governance looks like in regulated and security-cleared environments

### Power Platform

- Power Platform architecture, security and DLP
- An understanding of SharePoint and Dataverse as data stores
- Ability to set the guardrails and governance for citizen-developer and pro-developer use

### AI, Copilot and Agents

- Practical, hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Studio — building and deploying agents, not just advising on them
- Understanding of AI licensing models, governance and the data readiness that underpins successful AI adoption
- Awareness of AI risks, data considerations and responsible-AI practices

### Communication, Influence and Leadership

- Genuine ability to communicate and build credibility with senior stakeholders and founders
- Experience making architectural decisions and defending technical recommendations under pressure
- Comfortable leading workshops, discovery sessions and knowledge transfer
- Track record of growing technical capability in others — mentoring, enabling, not gatekeeping

---

## Desirable Skills and Experience

- Microsoft certifications (MS-102, Power Platform Solution Architect Expert, SC-400/SC-100, AI-900, Azure architect-level credentials or equivalent)
- Experience leading an internal transformation or AI ways-of-working programme
- Background spanning both technical architecture and consulting or advisory work
- Experience integrating or architecting across non-Microsoft SaaS platforms (Salesforce, Workday, ServiceNow) or a demonstrable platform-agnostic architecture approach
- Experience with PowerShell automation and the Microsoft Graph API
- Experience delivering solutions to public sector or security-cleared environments
- Prior experience building a technical practice or centre of excellence from scratch

---

## Compensation and Progression

**Base salary:** £120,000

**Performance bonus:** 15-20% of base, tied to personal and business performance metrics agreed at the start of each year.

**Long-term upside:** We want this role to share in the value it creates. We'll structure a long-term upside mechanism — phantom equity or AI/architecture practice profit-share — with vesting over four years. We'll agree the right structure together based on what works for the business.

**Progression:** We see this role growing with the business. The scope here is to build and own the architecture capability. As the practice grows and the Frontier Firm ambition matures, this role naturally expands — in remit, in team, and in reward.

---

## What We Offer

Because we embrace the opportunities from the technology we help roll out, we have flexible working patterns to fit in with your travel, families, personal development and other activities. We think this helps our team be the fully rounded experts our clients need.

We give you company leave between Christmas and New Year, monthly staff recognition rewards, contributory pension, private medical care, death-in-service cover and support for your learning and development.

Our support for employees under the WeCare scheme offers a range of benefits, including access to legal advice and online GP appointments. Some of our team are trained mental health first aiders and we're always reviewing how we support people's wellbeing.

On top of your salary, we offer referral fees to employees and contractors.

---

## About Inform

We are The Inform Team — experts in making digital transformation personal. A mix of change managers, communicators, designers, trainers and strategists, all united by a shared purpose: to make change happen.

What started as two lifelong friends at their kitchen tables has grown into a thriving team of over 90 experts and collaborators. Emma Henry and Samantha Kinstrey founded The Inform Team with one clear mission: to put people at the heart of technology change.

We're a remote-first organisation spanning the UK and beyond. We've worked with public and private sector organisations to help them adopt new technologies and ways of working — from assessing digital maturity and recommending changes, to shaping how that change is delivered, creating engaging communications and tailored training programmes.

**Our areas of expertise:** AI Adoption · Microsoft 365 adoption · Change and behaviours · Communications and engagement · Learning and adoption · Pharma and life sciences

---

*Chief Architect role profile — negotiated version, June 2026. For Dom's use in shaping the conversation with Erica Jefferies and The Inform Team leadership. Companion to the original posted JD (Senior Solutions Architect).*

---

## Role Summary

This is a foundational appointment — the first architecture-level leader in the business. The role owns technical direction inside The Inform Team and across the client base, spanning two missions:

**Client-facing architecture.** Trusted technical authority for Microsoft 365/Copilot/Power Platform clients. Many organisations want to roll out Copilot and agents but haven't done the groundwork — data governance, SharePoint structure, permissions, DLP. Dom frames the problem, designs the target architecture, sizes the effort, sequences the work.

**Frontier Firm — internal AI transformation.** Owns the strategic direction of how The Inform Team transforms its own operations using AI agents. Designs how human-agent teams operate, sets the guardrails, runs the pilots, creates the patterns the rest of the business adopts. This needs dedicated, focused ownership — it can't be split across multiple projects.

---

## Key Responsibilities

### Architecture Leadership and Practice Building
- Own the technical direction of The Inform Team's AI and Architecture capability
- Define architecture standards, patterns and principles across client and internal delivery
- Build a reusable set of accelerators, frameworks and reference architectures that scale delivery
- Advance Microsoft partner status — pursue and achieve relevant Microsoft Solutions Partner designations
- Develop the architecture practice: mentor and grow colleagues into credible practitioners
- Act as escalation point for complex architectural decisions
- Represent The Inform Team externally as a technical authority

### Solution and Data Architecture
- End-to-end solutions across Microsoft 365, Power Platform and Azure — secure, scalable, compliant
- Lead data architecture for clients: classification, information protection, retention, lifecycle
- Design Microsoft Purview: DLP, sensitivity labels, classification, retention, records management, insider risk, eDiscovery
- Assess and remediate SharePoint/M365 estates for AI/Copilot readiness
- Define AI-readiness governance baseline before deploying agents over client data
- Identity and access models: Entra ID, conditional access, RBAC, guest/B2B lifecycle
- High-quality architecture artefacts: target-state designs, options appraisals, roadmaps
